headline: Chase Sapphire Preferred Offers 100K Point Welcome Bonus
reasoning: This topic has high travel relevance and reader value as it directly impacts points and miles strategy and offers significant savings for travelers. The information is highly actionable and timely, detailing a current, strong welcome offer that readers can apply for immediately. The source, One Mile at a Time, is a well-established and credible authority in the points and miles space.
summary: The Chase Sapphire Preferred card is currently offering a 100,000 Ultimate Rewards points welcome bonus after meeting spending requirements, which is one of the best offers seen for the card. This comes after a recent refresh of the card's benefits and features.

source_articles.title: Chase Sapphire Preferred Bonus Hits 100K Points — Here’s What To Consider
source_articles.excerpt: The Chase Sapphire Preferred Card has recently undergone a major refresh, and the changes are a mixed bag, with some people better off, and some worse off. It’s still one of my top recommendations for beginners and people who value Chase Ultimate Rewards points, and don’t mind the recent Hyatt devaluation (or are willing to pair this card with one that makes the devaluation immaterial).
